claim: Microsoft's fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 revenue was about $90 billion.
summary: As of the 2026-01-04 knowledge cutoff, Microsoft's fiscal Q4 2026 (ending June 30, 2026) had not yet occurred or been reported, so the claimed ~$90 billion revenue cannot be established from existing knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 revenue was about $90 billion.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, which predates the end of Microsoft's fiscal Q4 2026 (quarter ending June 30, 2026) and its earnings report in late July 2026; the value cannot be established from pre-cutoff knowledge and no citations may be invented.
